name: Marching Cubes with Disjoint Patch Decomposition
definition: A variant of Marching Cubes that decomposes the surface within a cube into disjoint patches (connected components of edges) to handle ambiguous cases (e.g., saddle points) by ensuring topological correctness through graph-based coloring.
summary: Marching Cubes with Disjoint Patch Decomposition resolves topological ambiguities by decomposing voxel surfaces into disjoint edge patches, ensuring manifold correctness unlike standard lookup tables.
